description: Create or update a public share link: anyone with the link gets the given role, no Proton account needed. Calling again on the same path REPLACES the link's settings (same URL): omitting password/expiration removes them. So when the path already has a link with a password and/or expiration that this call omits, the call is refused before any change, naming what would be lost, unless resetSettings=true (also refused when the existing settings cannot be read). Expiration is at most ~90 days out. Returns {url?, role?, expirationTime?, warning?}; fields may be absent. The password is passed as a CLI argument and is visible in the process list and shell history of the machine running this server. For private sharing use drive_share_invite. The server asks the user to approve this itself.

confirmed.description: Optional and ignored: the server asks the user to approve this itself. You do not need to send it.

expiration.description: Optional expiration date in ISO format, e.g. '2026-06-06'. Omit for no expiration.

password.description: Optional custom password required to access the link. Omit for no password.

path.description: Absolute remote Drive path to create a public link for (must start with '/').

resetSettings.description: Set true to deliberately drop an existing link's password and/or expiration that this call does not pass again. Without it such a call is refused.

role.description: Access level for anyone with the link. Defaults to 'viewer' if omitted.

name: drive_share_set_url
title: Create or update public link
